scope_limits: R5 is a separate native agent, not a new population or independent confirmation.
Frozen predictions replayed and readers independently refitted will be counted separately.
Exact finite-law constraints are not held-out utility or population privacy guarantees.
No point or confidence criterion changes after outcomes; technical successors preserve prior attempts.
Off-device custody and remote source verification remain pending unless actually completed.
